name: github-pull-requests-manager
title: GitHub Enterprise Pull Requests Manager
description: Manage GitHub Enterprise pull requests with a focused workflow — track approvals, comments, conflicts, CI status, and review requests. Also supports GitHub.com.
author: mickaelalvs

preferences.name: githubEnterpriseUrl
preferences.title: GitHub URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your GitHub instance. Use https://github.com for GitHub.com or your enterprise URL (e.g. https://github.mycompany.com).

preferences.name: githubToken
preferences.title: Personal Access Token
preferences.description: GitHub personal access token with repo and read:org scopes

preferences.name: filterLabel
preferences.title: Filter by Label
preferences.description: Only show pull requests with at least one of these labels in Wait For Review. Separate multiple labels with commas. Leave empty to show all.

commands.name: my-pull-requests
commands.title: All Pull Requests
commands.subtitle: GitHub
commands.description: All your GitHub Enterprise pull requests — My PRs and review requests in one view.

commands.name: my-prs
commands.title: My Pull Requests
commands.subtitle: GitHub
commands.description: Pull requests you authored or are assigned to — track approvals and CI status.

commands.name: reviewing
commands.title: Reviewing
commands.subtitle: GitHub
commands.description: Pull requests where you are requested as a reviewer.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
